anomalies.description: A man in a dark coat delivers a high kick to an opponent in military uniform, making contact with the opponent's upper body/shoulder area.; A man in a dark coat delivers a high kick to a soldier in uniform, who is thrown backward against a wall and ladder.

A man in dark clothing engages in a physical fight with a soldier in olive-green uniform, involving grappling, throwing (f0), close-quarters struggle (f4–f6), and a decisive strike that knocks the soldier down (f10–f11).

A man in a suit grabs a soldier by the throat and lifts him off the ground in a chokehold.; Two soldiers engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat, with one delivering a punch or strike to the other's face/neck area.
A man in dark clothing delivers a punch to a soldier in olive-green uniform, who is then thrown backward and falls to the ground.
A man in a suit grabs and restrains a small child by the shoulders/upper arms, holding him against a wall while the child looks distressed; the child is clearly unable to resist.

The same man in dark clothing grabs the collar of a different (or same) soldier and appears to choke or strangle him against a wall.; A man in a dark jacket grabs and strikes a soldier in a green uniform; the soldier is visibly reacting to being attacked, with his head pulled back and face contorted in pain.; The man in dark clothing engages in a physical struggle with another soldier, delivering a blow that causes the soldier to fall unconscious on the ground.

The soldier is struck again and falls to the ground, appearing incapacitated; the attacker continues to engage while the victim lies helpless on the ground.; The soldier lies motionless on the ground, eyes closed, with visible facial injury and blood near mouth/nose, indicating he is unconscious or severely injured and defenseless.
A man in a black robe grabs a child by the neck and lifts him off the ground, then holds him suspended in a threatening manner.

A man lifts and carries a child in a manner suggesting non-consensual restraint or force; the child appears limp and unresponsive, with head tilted back and eyes closed, while the man holds them tightly against his chest and moves through a narrow alley.
